audience: shift managers and HR teams who plan rotas, absences and time records in Orkelis

useCases.title: See the plannings and active agents for a period
useCases.text: List the planning assignments and shifts between two dates, with optional service and shift type filters. Filter the agents by status, for example ACTIVE.

useCases.title: Review the absences and leave requests of a month
useCases.text: List absences and leave requests in a date range, filtered by agent or type. Use the types to separate sick leave, paid leave and training.

useCases.title: Record sick leave and cancel a mistaken absence
useCases.text: Create a sick-leave or other absence for an agent on the dates you give. Cancel an absence by its id if it was entered by mistake.

useCases.title: Add, update or deactivate an agent
useCases.text: Create an agent with the role AGENT, change only the fields you pass, or deactivate an agent. A deactivated agent stays in the account but is no longer scheduled.

useCases.title: Compare clock-in times with the planned shifts
useCases.text: List the clock-in and clock-out entries between two dates, with optional agent and method filters. Compare them with the plannings for the same days.
